Class GameData

java.lang.Object
game.GameData
public class GameData extends Object
Stores all global data related to the current game session. This class centralizes the state of the game such as hero data, inventory, map, events, score, and screen information. GameData acts as the main data holder shared between the different systems of the game (combat, UI, map, events, shop ...).
